# RB-21 Access changes

Scope: NabaLens internal. Back to the [index](README.md).

| Field                         | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Trigger                       | A joiner, leaver, venue move or manager change, Access that looks wrong                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Operator role                 | OPS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| First checks                  | Confirm the request through an authorised channel. Read the person's account kind, venue and grants in Staff and Coverage, Venue managers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Steps                         | Joiner: invite from Staff. Leaver: Deactivate (SW-12). Venue move: edit the venue in Staff; past months stay with the old venue. Manager access: Make venue manager or Return to staff account in Staff, or grant and revoke under Coverage, Venue managers (SW-13), each with a reason. Never share an account, bypass the admin screens or edit profiles in SQL. Admin accounts are changed only by an authorised operator through the provider procedure. |
| Narrowest switch              | One account (SW-12) or one grant (SW-13)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Switches in the catalogue     | SW-12 (One staff account), SW-13 (One venue-manager grant)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Data implications             | Every change is audited; the person's photos, credit and history stay with them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Pending delivery              | No consumer delivery is involved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Readback that proves recovery | The person sees exactly their venue's tools on next page load, and History lists the change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
